
295 MB, mtime is now, no rotation. The LaunchAgent `com.rico.open-brain-local-clone` runs `local-clone-autostart.sh` and redirects stdout there for the life of the machine. The service itself is healthy (not crash-looping); this is the log, not the data.

`mlx-embedding-server.log` in the same directory is 6.8 MB and growing the same way.

## Done means
